question: Which Article of the Constitution separates the judiciary from the executive?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 50**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Part IV of the Indian Constitution from Articles 36 to 51 mentions the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSPs).
 
• Article 50__ gives the principle of separation of the Judiciary from the executive.<span st
